messages: My husband Ravi wants to move to his hometown and I don't. We've argued about it for weeks.
He says his parents need him nearby. I think that's an excuse. What's my strongest move?

sketch.goal: Reach a decision about the move the user can live with, without endless re-arguing

people.name: You
people.wants: to not move to his hometown
people.fears: being pushed into a move she doesn't want

options.do: Tell Ravi plainly that you don't want to move, and name what you'd need to even consider it
Say the move is off the table for now and stop re-arguing it
Keep arguing the point every time he brings it up until he drops it
Talk through what he wants from the move and listen to your side
Keep pressing the move or shut down the conversation
